dataset: NASA C-MAPSS turbofan engine degradation simulation data set
note: Simulated by NASA's C-MAPSS engine model, not field data. The repository does not redistribute it: scripts/fetch_cmapss.py downloads it and checks every byte against this manifest.
inner_zip: 6. Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set/CMAPSSData.zip
terms: The repository asks users to acknowledge it and the data donors. Users take the data at their own risk; neither NASA nor the donors accept liability. No licence text accompanies the data.
cite: A. Saxena and K. Goebel (2008). Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set, NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, CA.

A. Saxena, K. Goebel, D. Simon and N. Eklund (2008). Damage Propagation Modeling for Aircraft Engine Run-to-Failure Simulation. Proceedings of the 1st International Conference on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM08), Denver CO.
